type.notes: 1440-scroll-75.jpg: Cormorant/Source Serif/DM Mono coherent, italic reviews strong, tabular price ranges. Review attribution breaks '5 of / 5' with stranded SAMPLE REVIEW tag on all three cards (-0.5).

photo.notes: Drawn treatment judged on merit: 1440-scroll-25.jpg marsh break and 1440-scroll-50.jpg piazza share one palette and line language, nothing broken or blank. 1440-full.jpg prep row: all houses reuse the identical window/shutter tile and none shows the defect its plaque names (-0.5).

copy.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: specific trade nouns (piazza, mildewcide, louvers), dry local voice, sample labels throughout, Price it consistent. 1440-full.jpg services: nine identical 'Price it' links flatten the voice (-0.5).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: no overflow (render.json 320/390), prep 2x2, piazza unpinned and readable, timeline fits, mobile bar present. Prep plaques wrap to 4-5 lines in the 2-up grid (-0.5).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg: full content in reduced motion, sample tags visible, labelled form. mustFix: 1440-scroll-25.jpg break caption in small cream mono crosses dark silhouettes and pale horizon bands, failing contrast on 'it settles back'.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: piazza pins and steps through four rows with an active state; color explorer recolours the house. 1440-first.jpg: concept's shutter intro still absent, hero signature static (-1.0). Pin holds ~2100px for 4 text steps while the porch drawing never changes (-0.5).

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg: color explorer recolours a drawn single house, price sheet mini-house responds to the size slider, painting-day timeline on the marsh: designed outputs. 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the piazza, the most Charleston image, stays static through its story (-0.5).

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: footer house-row mark with plaque, honest 'drawn for this sample' credit, zero radius throughout, print on price sheet. Plaque shadow offsets inconsistent between 1440-first.jpg hero plaque and the estimator ochre slab (-0.5).

mustFix.problem: Cream mono caption 'We start when the dew burns off and stop before it settles back.' runs across dark house silhouettes and pale horizon bands; 'it settles back' fails contrast
mustFix.fix: Move the caption up into the dark sky gradient above the skyline, or set it on a solid #1a1c1e plaque with 8px 12px padding; cap its width at 38ch so it ends before the first roofline

elevate.move: Make the piazza pin paint the porch: as the four steps advance, the ceiling goes from grey with mildew spots, to washed, to white primer, to haint blue in two sweeps across the bead boards. Open the hero with the promised shutters swinging open on the centre house, so the signature moves at both ends of the walk.

Give services a place on the street: turn #services into a second, shorter row of nine small facades, one per job, each wearing its plaque, on a darker plaster tone, so the light paper runs break into a walk with a loud/quiet rhythm.
